integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames the professional woman shown in <Picture 1> seated at her sleek desk in a modern securities firm office, preserving her appearance, business attire, and the surrounding workstation with dual monitors displaying stock data. Floor-to-ceiling windows behind her reveal a city skyline in daylight. She raises her right hand with a graceful wrist rotation and flicks her fingers upward; a semi-transparent, luminous blue-cyan holographic K-line candlestick diagram materializes in the air above the desk, glowing softly. She tilts her head slightly to the right with a subtle, charming smile, tucking a strand of hair behind her left ear with her free hand. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed from medium-wide to medium shot as the woman with a confident, alluring yet professional voice (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] K线就像股票的体检报告。一根K线，记录了四个关键数据：开盘价、收盘价、最高价、最低价，缺一不可。</d> While speaking, she extends her index finger and traces four small glowing dots that appear on the holographic K-line one by one — each dot pulses brighter as she names its corresponding price. She maintains direct eye contact with the camera throughout, her lips syncing precisely to every syllable, a faint playful smirk lingering at the corners of her mouth.

overall_soundscape: Low office ambient hum from air conditioning and computer fans continues throughout. Her fingers produce a soft tap each time she touches the holographic surface, accompanied by a faint electronic chime. A distant phone ring is audible from a neighboring desk, and the subtle rustle of her blazer fabric as she moves adds texture.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot frames the professional woman shown in <Picture 1> seated at her desk in the securities firm office, with the holographic K-line diagram still glowing in the air before her. She gently taps the central rectangular body of the holographic K-line with her right index finger; the entity section expands and glows brighter in response, splitting into a red candlestick and a green candlestick side by side. She leans forward slightly, her eyes narrowing with a teasing, knowing look as the woman (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 红色代表上涨，绿色代表下跌。中间这个矩形实体，就是开盘价和收盘价的差距，我们叫它'实体'。</d> The camera pans right with small amplitude at slow speed, following her gesture toward the two highlighted candlesticks. As she says "红色" and "绿色," she points to each respective candlestick, which pulses in sync. She bites her lower lip briefly after saying "实体," then gives a small, satisfied nod, her fingertips brushing the holographic surface with a delicate flick, sending a ripple of light across the diagram.

overall_soundscape: The steady office air-conditioning hum persists beneath the soft electronic hum of the holographic display. Her fingertips produce gentle tap sounds against the holographic interface, followed by subtle crystalline chimes as the candlestick colors activate. The faint click of her keyboard and the murmur of distant colleagues talking in the hallway add realistic office ambience.

overall_soundscape: The office ambient hum continues steadily. The holographic thermometer produces a faint glass-like vibration sound as the mercury level changes. integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames the professional woman shown in <Picture 1> at her office desk. With a flick of both wrists, she dismisses the thermometer hologram and expands the K-line diagram, splitting it into two enlarged candlesticks floating side by side — one red with its close near the top, one green with its close near the bottom. She pushes her right palm forward toward the red candlestick; its upper portion glows intensely, and a small upward arrow icon appears above it. She then turns her palm toward the green candlestick; its lower portion darkens and a downward arrow icon appears. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed from medium-wide to a medium-close shot, tightening on her face and the two candlesticks. She straightens her posture slightly, her expression shifting to a more focused, professional look with a hint of allure, one eyebrow subtly raised, as the woman (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 所以，收盘价接近最高价，说明多方力量很强；反过来，接近最低价，就说明空方占优了。记住了吗？</d> She taps her temple lightly with her index finger on "记住了吗？", then points at the camera with the same finger, her lips pressed into a playful, knowing smile.

overall_soundscape: The office ambient hum persists beneath the soft electronic pulse of the holographic display. Her palm pressing against the holographic interface produces a deep, resonant bass tone, and the arrow icons appearing generate crisp digital blips. The squeak of her office chair as she straightens her posture and the subtle tap of her finger against her temple add tactile realism.

She leans back slightly in her chair, crossing one leg over the other beneath the desk, and lifts her chin with a confident, radiant smile. Her hands sweeping through the holographic field produce a broad, resonant shimmer sound, and the golden pulse of the diagram emits a warm, bell-like chime.
